name: is-cross-border
description: Prepare Iceland cross-border tax screening workpapers for 2026. Establish domestic residence, identify non-resident income categories, distinguish services from rights and financing, screen permanent establishments and prepare treaty exemption or refund applications. Covers national company rates, residence boundaries, payer evidence and departure checks. Use for foreign contractors, royalties, dividends, interest, remote work, branches and international moves. Includes a resident foreign-relief workpaper, conditional UK company and individual credit examples and the qualifying company migration (exit) computation. It does not cover every treaty corridor. General reference only; apply it to the client's documented facts.
